subject: Starting WS D live smoke (claude-cli, ~$6, 4 arms)
body: User approved one cheap live seed per arm via --llm claude-cli: R0, R1-demo_realist, R1-demo_realist-prompt, R1-bad; 2 iterations x 3 samples, 1 eval/iter, ~115 calls each. Could not lock autoresearch/ (overlaps C1/A locks), so instead it runs from a detached git worktree pinned at d49802193ec9e4e4f5efe6c8442ddca387cd9f58, so edits in the main checkout cannot mix code versions mid-run. Results -> results/research_smoke_d/ with CODE_VERSION. Known caveat: claude-cli harness leak (I13); this checks the arms run end to end and what they cost, not findings.
